reasons.persona_fit: Accurately targets the small business owner-operator, aligns with Bareni's bounded delivery model, respects scope boundaries, and strictly observes the no-CTA rule.
reasons.clarity: Logical and plain structure immediately identifies the cost of scope drift and contrasts open-ended arrangements with bounded pilots.
reasons.actionability: Provides a feasible, manual diagnostic exercise (identifying workflow, hours, and target outcome) to evaluate retainers versus bounded projects.
reasons.factual_grounding: Every claim is grounded in evidence; properly qualifies the 8–10 hours scenario drag, delivery sequence, and human approval safeguards.
